Understanding the paper's structural details and reaction paths is non-trivial; a solving agent must correctly translate the paper's description of grids, binding sites, and intermediate structures into a working DFT workflow.

This requires orchestrating several DFT calculations, managing pseudopotentials, and merging results into CSV artifacts, which is a multi-stage pipeline with dependencies and careful I/O handling.
